[`DataAdapter`](DataAdapter.md)

## DataAdapter interface

Work directly with files and folders inside a vault. If possible prefer using the [Vault](docs/obsidian_docs/obsidian_dev_docs/en/Reference/TypeScript%20API/Vault.md) API over this.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export interface DataAdapter 
```
